sections.shortTitle: Islamabad Capital Territory Shops Business and Industrial Establishment Security Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ISLAMABAD CAPITAL TERRITORY SHOPS, BUSINESS AND INDUSTRIAL ESTABLISHMENT
(SECURITY) ORDINANCE, 2000
ISLAMABAD CAPITAL
TERRITORY SHOPS, BUSINESS AND INDUSTRIAL ESTABLISHMENT (SECURITY) ORDINANCE,
2000
ORDINANCE XXX OF 2000
An Ordinance to
provide for the security of shops, business and industrial establishments in
the Islamabad Capital Territory
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 2000]
No.F.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
27-7-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Islamabad Capital
Territory Shops, Business and Industrial Establishment (Security) Ordinance,
2000.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the Islamabad Capital Territory.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.
